topics.label: Introduction and Hallmarks of Cancer Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session, recaps previous material, outlines the learning objectives, and establishes the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferative Signaling and Growth Regulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in signaling cascades, including Wnt, receptor tyrosine kinases, Ras/MAPK, PI3K, and TGF-beta, confer independence from growth stimulation and resistance to growth inhibition.

topics.label: Differentiation Blockades in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how oncogenic mutations arrest cells in immature, proliferative stages using examples from hematopoietic malignancies and intestinal crypt epithelium.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis, Replicative Immortality, and p53 Stress Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the mechanisms by which cancer cells overcome intrinsic tumor-suppressive fail-safes through apoptotic resistance, telomere maintenance, and the bypass of p53-mediated stress and senescence pathways.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the shift to aerobic glycolysis, the metabolic adaptations across different tumor types, and the role of onco-metabolites in driving epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis and the Angiogenic Switch
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the necessity of vascular recruitment for tumor survival beyond oxygen diffusion limits, the timing of blood vessel formation, and the balance of angiogenic regulators.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Clinical Monitoring of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides a comprehensive analysis of metastatic dissemination, lymphatic and hematogenous spread, circulating tumor cell monitoring, and the genetic and microenvironmental determinants of secondary colonization.

topics.label: Conclusion and Practical Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by reflecting on hallmark literature complexity, summarizing the core takeaways, and previewing the upcoming practical sessions.
